newsitem.title: USA: Pacific Gateway Properties Q3 loss.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Gateway Properties Q3 loss.

text.p: Pacific Gateway Properties Monday reported net loss of $549,000 or $0.13 a share for the third quarter of 1996, compared to a net loss of $1,398,000 or $0.34 a share for the third quarter of 1995.
Net income for the first nine months of 1996 amounted to $6,419,000 or $1.53 per share, compared to a net loss of $1,952,000 for the first nine months of 1995.

PGP also reported that the Weston, Fla. and Tucson, Ariz. properties were refinanced with fixed interest rate mortgage debt. In September, PGP completed the refinancing of $3,850,000 of mortgage debt related to the Tucson building.

This debt was due in the fourth quarter of 1997. The new loan carries a 9.62 percent annual interest rate until maturity with monthly amortization payments calculated using a 25-year amortization schedule.

The terms of the debt require PGP to fund reserves for future tenant improvements, leasing commissions and debt service up to a specified limit. The debt is nonrecourse, has a prepayment penalty during the first four years of the loan, and matures Oct. 1, 2006.

In October, PGP completed the refinancing of $1,000,000 of mortgage debt related to the Weston, Fla. building. The debt was due in the fourth quarter of 1997. The new loan carries an 8.45 percent annual interest rate until maturity with monthly amortization payments calculated using a 15-year amortization schedule.
